Excuse me. 用于与陌生人搭话、打断说话或从别人身边挤过。
Pardon? 是 I beg your pardon? 的省略，请对方把刚才的话重复一遍。
原来这是一个“是不是”的问句
Is this your ...? 用来问“这是你的……吗？”
is 是 be 动词；问句把 is 放在前面。Yes, it is. 里的 it 指刚才那件东西。
手提包最后回到了谁手里？
没有听清对方的话，应该怎么说？
新路线的终点是一座房子，要挂哪张英文牌？
这里的 it 接着指前一句问到的手表。
Does the man get his umbrella back?
这位男士拿回他的雨伞了吗？
My coat and my umbrella please.
Here's your umbrella and your coat.
Is this it? 中的 it 指代前文提到的物品。
请把我的大衣和伞拿给我。
这是我（寄存东西）的牌子。
Good morning. 是英语中常见的问候用语。
This is ... 用来把某人介绍给他人。
Nice to meet you. 用于初次见面等非正式场合。
这位是索菲娅·杜邦小姐。

be 动词现在时第一人称单数
What's your job? 中 What's = What is.
What nationality are you? 用来询问对方国籍。
Complete these sentences using am or is.
Write questions and answers using his, her, he, she, a or an.
I am / You are 用来介绍身份。an engineer 用 an；a teacher 用 a。问职业用 What’s your job?，问国籍用 What nationality are you?。
Nice to see you, too, Steven.
史蒂文，见到你我也很高兴。
How are you? 用来询问对方近况。
And you? 相当于 And how are you?
Nice to see you. 用于再次见面。
我见到你也很高兴，史蒂文。
Look at that man. He is fat.
Look at that woman. She is thin.
Look at that policeman. He is tall.
Look at that policewoman. She is short.
Look at that mechanic. He is dirty.
Look at that nurse. She is clean.
Look at Steven. He is hot.
Look at Emma. She is cold.
Look at that milkman. He is old.
Look at that air hostess. She is young.
Look at that hairdresser. He is busy.
Look at that housewife. She is lazy.
Complete these sentences using He's, She's or It's.
Write sentences using He or She.
How are you? 问候身体或近况；I’m fine./I’m very well. 可以回答。He is / She is 描述一个人；tall/short、hot/cold 等成对理解。
Whose shirt is that? 用 Whose 询问归属。
Is this shirt Tim's? 中 Tim's 表示 Tim 的衬衫。
Here you are. 表示把东西递给对方。
Whose is this handbag? It's Stella's.
Whose is this car? It's Paul's.
Whose is this coat? It's Sophie's.
Whose is this umbrella? It's Steven's.
Whose is this pen? It's my son's.
Whose is this dress? It's my daughter's.
Whose is this suit? It's my father's.
Whose is this skirt? It's my mother's.
Whose is this blouse? It's my sister's.
Whose is this tie? It's my brother's.
Complete these sentences using my, your, his or her.
Write questions and answers using 's, his and her.
Whose …? 问“谁的”。my/your/his/her 放在名词前。Tim’s shirt 表示蒂姆的衬衫，所有者的名字后加 ’s。
安娜的帽子是什么颜色的？
你的新连衣裙是什么颜色的？
那真是一顶漂亮的帽子！
Come upstairs and see it. 表示邀请对方上楼来看。
What colour's your umbrella? It's black.
What colour's your car? It's blue.
What colour's your shirt? It's white.
What colour's your coat? It's grey.
What colour's your case? It's brown.
What colour's your carpet? It's red.
What colour's your blouse? It's yellow.
What colour's your tie? It's orange.
What colour's your hat? It's grey and black.
What colour's your dog? It's brown and white.
Write sentences using 's, his or her.
What colour is …? 问单个物品的颜色。the same colour 表示相同颜色；green 既能作颜色名，也能放在名词前。
Is there a problem with the customs officer?
海关官员那里有问题吗？
你们的朋友也是丹麦人吗？
你们的朋友也是游客吗？
friend、tourist 和 case 在这里使用复数形式。
What colour are your books? Our books are red.
What colour are your shirts? Our shirts are white.
What colour are your coats? Our coats are grey.
What colour are your tickets? Our tickets are yellow.
What colour are your suits? Our suits are blue.
What colour are your hats? Our hats are black and grey.
What colour are your passports? Our passports are green.
What colour are your umbrellas? Our umbrellas are black.
What colour are your handbags? Our handbags are white.
What colour are your ties? Our ties are orange.
What colour are your dogs? Our dogs are brown and white.
What colour are your pens? Our pens are blue.
What colour are your cars? Our cars are red.
What colour are your dresses? Our dresses are green.
What colour are your blouses? Our blouses are yellow.
Complete these sentences using a or an.
Write questions and answers using our.
I am 变成多人时用 We are；He/She is 变成多人时用 They are。these 指这些，those 指那些；复数物品搭配 are。
What are Michael Baker and Jeremy Short's jobs?
迈克尔·贝克和杰瑞米·肖特是做什么工作的？
Come and meet our employees, Mr. Richards.
理查兹先生，来见见我们的雇员吧。
他是我们的办公室助理。
How do you do? 是初次见面时的正式问候。
sales reps 是 sales representatives 的缩写。
office assistant 表示办公室助手。
来见见我们的雇员，理查兹先生。
他是我们的办公室助手。
What are their jobs? They're sales reps.
What are their jobs? They're keyboard operators.
What are their jobs? They're mechanics.
What are their jobs? They're engineers.
What are their jobs? They're hairdressers.
What are their jobs? They're teachers.
What are their jobs? They're customs officers.
What are their jobs? They're taxi drivers.
What are their jobs? They're nurses.
What are their jobs? They're air hostesses.
What are their jobs? They're housewives.
What are their jobs? They're milkmen.
What are their jobs? They're postmen.
What are their jobs? They're policemen.
What are their jobs? They're policewomen.
Complete these sentences using He, She, We or They.
Who are they? 问多人身份；What are their jobs? 问多人职业。employees、assistants 等复数通常加 s；man 的复数是 men。
They are not mechanics. They are sales reps.
他们不是机械师，他们是销售代表。
这些女士是键盘操作员。
Why do the children thank their mother?
孩子们为什么感谢他们的妈妈？
那儿有个卖冰淇淋的人。
What's the matter? 用来询问对方怎么了。
There's 是 There is 的缩写。
那儿有一个卖冰淇淋的人。
Complete these sentences using am, is or are.
What’s the matter? 问怎么了。tired 是累，thirsty 是渴。they are + 形容词描述一组人或物；形容词本身不加复数 s。
Are the shoes dirty or clean?
They are not dirty. They are clean.
Give me a book please, Jane.
No, not that one. The red one.
不，不是那一本。是红色的那一本。
一个（代替前面提到的单数名词）
which 用来问“哪一个”。用 one 避免重复单数名词：the red one 指红色的那一本书。a/an 用在可数名词单数前；an empty glass。
给我们一个干净的杯子。
Give me some glasses please, Jane.
one 代替单数名词，ones 代替复数名词。the ones on the shelf 是“架子上的那些”。some 后接可数名词时用复数，如 some glasses。
These magazines are on the bed.

史密斯太太的厨房很小。
There is a refrigerator in the kitchen.
There is an electric cooker in the kitchen.
There is a table in the middle of the room.
There is a bottle on the table.
There is a cup on the table, too.
There is + 单数名词表示“有一个……”。in 表示在里面，on 表示在表面；on the left/right 表示在左边/右边。Where is …? 用来问位置。
There is a cup on the table.
The refrigerator is on the right.
The cooker is in the kitchen.
There is a book on the table.
Mrs. Smith's living room is large.
史密斯太太的客厅很大。
There is a television in the room.
The television is near the window.
There are some magazines on the television.
There is a table in the room.
There are some newspapers on the table.
There are some armchairs in the room.
The armchairs are near the table.
There is a stereo in the room.
房间里有一套立体声音响。
The stereo is near the door.
There are some books on the stereo.
There are some pictures in the room.
The pictures are on the wall.
There is 后接单数，There are 后接复数。询问多个物品的位置用 Where are …?，回答用 They are …。trousers 是复数形式。
There are some pictures on the wall.
There is a stereo near the door.
Are there any plates in the kitchen?
There are not any books on the table.

two thousand two hundred and thirty
three thousand three hundred and forty

What must I do, Mrs. Jones?
琼斯太太，我必须做些什么？
Open the window and air the room.
打开窗户，给房间通通风。
Then put these clothes in the wardrobe.
然后把这些衣服放进衣柜。
must 后面用动词原形。指令常从动词开始：Open the window. 开窗；Turn on the light. 开灯。make the bed 表示整理床铺。
Put these clothes in the wardrobe.
Is Tim in the garden, too?
The dog's in the garden, too.
am/is/are + 动词 -ing 表示正在进行。sit → sitting，run → running，type → typing。人物猫用 he/she；课文中普通宠物狗和猫用 it。tooth 的复数是 teeth。
She is sitting under the tree.
The dog is eating a bone.
She is not emptying the basket.
It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky, but the sun is shining.
天空中有些云，但阳光灿烂。
Mr. Jones is with his family.
琼斯先生和家人在一起。
They are walking over the bridge.
There are some boats on the river.
Mr. Jones and his wife are looking at them.
琼斯先生和妻子正看着那些小船。
Sally is looking at a big ship.
The ship is going under the bridge.
Tim is looking at an aeroplane.
The aeroplane is flying over the river.
多个人正在做事，用 They are + 动词 -ing。over 表示从上方，under 表示从下方。look at 表示看，wait for 表示等待。

three hundred and thirty-one thousand three hundred and forty-two
four hundred and forty-two thousand four hundred and fifty-three

This is a photograph of our village.
这是我们村庄的一张照片。
Our village is in a valley.
我们的村庄在一个山谷里。
The village is on a river.
Here is another photograph of the village.
这是村庄的另一张照片。
My wife and I are walking along the banks of the river.
我和妻子正沿着河岸走。
There is a boy in the water.
He is swimming across the river.
The park is on the right.
Some children are coming out of the building.
一些孩子正从大楼里出来。
Some of them are going into the park.
他们中有些正走进公园。
along 是沿着，across 是横穿；into 是进入，out of 是从里面出来。beside 是在旁边，between 是在两者之间。注意游泳 crossing 与沿岸 walking 的方向。
The village is between two hills.
We are walking along the river.
They are going into the park.
They are coming out of the building.
She is sitting beside her mother.
Give me that hammer please, Dan.
What are you going to do now, George?
乔治，你现在打算做什么？
What colour are you going to paint it?
你打算把它漆成什么颜色？
I'm going to paint it pink.
我打算把它漆成粉红色。
粉红色是她最喜欢的颜色。
be going to + 动词原形表示打算做。I am making 描述现在正在做，I am going to paint 描述接下来的打算。listen to 表示听。
I am going to paint it pink.
She is going to do her homework.
We are going to listen to the stereo.
What are you going to do?
What are you going to do with that vase, Penny?
彭妮，你打算怎么处理那个花瓶？
I'm going to put it on this table, Sam.
萨姆，我打算把它放在这张桌子上。
What are you going to do with it?
I'm going to put it here, in front of the window.
我打算把它放在这里，窗户前面。
Put it here, on this shelf.
把它放在这里，这个架子上。
否定指令用 Don’t + 动词原形。Give it to me 和 Give me the vase 都可以表达把花瓶给我。it 代替前面说过的物品。
I am going to show it to her.
Put the vase on the shelf.
I am going to put them on.
I am going to turn it off.
A quarter of a pound of tea.
Is that tin of tobacco for me?
Well, it's certainly not for me!
一些（常用于疑问或否定句）
bread、cheese、milk 等通常作不可数名词。计量时说 a loaf of bread、a piece of cheese、a bottle of milk。一般询问是否有一些时用 Is there any …? 课文中的烟草只用于理解原文，不作为奖励或购买任务。
There is some cheese in the bag.
Give me a loaf of bread.
There is a bar of soap.
There is a bottle of milk.
Can you make the tea, Sam?
Yes, of course I can, Penny.
Is there any water in this kettle?
It's over there, behind the teapot.
I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.
我能看见茶壶，但看不见茶叶。
Ah yes, I can see it now.
There are some in the cupboard.
can 后用动词原形；can’t 表示不能。单数或不可数名词用 Is there any …?，复数用 Are there any …?。kettle 烧水，teapot 沏茶，两者不同。
Are there any cups in the cupboard?
Is there any water in the kettle?
The tea is behind the teapot.
There are some knives, but there are not any forks.
Can you come here a minute please, Bob?
鲍勃，请你来这里一下好吗？
先生，她在自己的办公室里。
Can she type this letter for me?
Can you type this letter for the boss please, Pamela?
帕梅拉，请你帮老板打这封信好吗？
can 表示能力，也用于请求：Can you …?。不能完成当前任务不等于不会这项技能；帕梅拉会打字，但看不懂这封信的字迹。
She can make cakes, but she cannot make biscuits.
她会做蛋糕，但不会做饼干。
好的，请给我一杯，克里斯廷。
I don't like milk in my coffee.
我不喜欢咖啡里加牛奶。
like 是通常的喜好，want 是现在想要。Do you like …? 回答 Yes, I do./No, I don’t.；接受食物用 Yes, please.，婉拒用 No, thank you.。教材中的酒类词保留在课本释义中，不设计为儿童选择饮用的任务。
I like apples, but I do not want one.
我喜欢苹果，但现在不想要一个。
I like butter, but I do not want any.
我喜欢黄油，但现在不想要。
Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?
伯德太太，您今天要买点肉吗？
Do you want beef or lamb?
I like lamb, but my husband doesn't.
我喜欢羊肉，但我丈夫不喜欢。
And a pound of mince, too.
Do you want a chicken, Mrs. Bird?
伯德太太，您想要一只鸡吗？
My husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.
我丈夫喜欢牛排，但不喜欢鸡肉。
To tell you the truth, Mrs. Bird, I don't like chicken either!
说实话，伯德太太，我也不喜欢鸡肉！
第三人称单数肯定句常用 likes/wants；否定句用 doesn’t like/want，动词不再加 s。either 放在否定句末表示“也不”。tomato/potato 的复数加 es。
I do not like chicken either.
She likes pears, but she does not want any.
她喜欢梨，但现在不想要。
What's the climate like in your country?
你们国家的气候怎么样？
What's the weather like in spring?
It's always warm in April and May, but it rains sometimes.
四月和五月总是暖和的，但有时下雨。
It's always hot in June, July and August.
六月、七月和八月总是很热。
Is it cold or warm in autumn?
It's always warm in September and October.
九月和十月总是暖和的。
It's often cold in November and it rains sometimes.
十一月经常冷，有时下雨。
Is it very cold in winter?
It's often cold in December, January and February.
十二月、一月和二月经常很冷。
come from 表示来自；主语 he/she/it 时用 comes，疑问句用 does 后改回 come。climate 指长期气候，weather 指天气。月份前常用 in。
It is often windy in March.
She is Dutch. She comes from the Netherlands.
她是荷兰人。她来自荷兰。
It's mild, but it's not always pleasant.
气候温和，但不总是宜人。
The weather's often cold in the North and windy in the East.
北部经常寒冷，东部经常刮风。
It's often wet in the West and sometimes warm in the South.
西部经常潮湿，南部有时暖和。
Which seasons do you like best?
The days are long and the nights are short.
The sun rises early and sets late.
I don't like autumn and winter.
The days are short and the nights are long.
The sun rises late and sets early.
Our climate is not very good, but it's certainly interesting.
我们的气候不算很好，但确实很有趣。
It's our favourite subject of conversation.
天气是我们最喜欢的谈话话题。
not always 表示不总是，不能理解成从不。表达国籍用 be + 国籍词，表达来自哪里用 come from + 国名。sun rises/sets 中动词用第三人称单数。
The weather is not always pleasant.
The days are long in summer.
The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.
索耶一家住在国王街 87 号。
In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.
早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。
Their father takes them to school every day.
他们的父亲每天送他们去上学。
Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.
索耶太太每天待在家里。
She always eats her lunch at noon.
In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.
In the evening, the children come home from school.
Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.
At night, the children always do their homework.
晚上，孩子们总是做作业。
Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper, but sometimes he and his wife watch television.
索耶先生通常看报纸，但有时他和妻子看电视。
日常习惯用一般现在时。he/she 后动词加 s 或 es：goes、does、washes；they 后用原形。arrive home 不加 to；in the morning，但 at noon/night。
She washes the dishes every day.
What does he do in the morning?
They do their homework at night.
She stays at home every day.
The children go to school by car every day, but today, they are going to school on foot.
孩子们每天乘车上学，但今天他们正步行去上学。
Mrs. Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning, but this morning, she is going to the shops.
索耶太太上午通常待在家里，但今天上午她正在去商店。
In the afternoon, Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room.
下午，索耶太太通常在客厅喝茶。
But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.
但今天下午她正在花园里喝茶。
In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework.
晚上孩子们通常做作业，但今晚他们没有在做作业。
At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
此刻，他们正在花园里玩。
Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night.
索耶先生通常在晚上看报纸。
But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.
但他今晚没有在看报纸。
At the moment, he's reading an interesting book.
此刻，他正在读一本有趣的书。
usually/every day 常与一般现在时搭配；now/at the moment 描述此刻，用 am/is/are + -ing。on foot 是步行，by car 是乘车。整点用 o’clock。
She usually drinks tea, but now she is drinking coffee.
她通常喝茶，但现在她正在喝咖啡。
They are going to school on foot today.
他们今天正步行去上学。
He is reading a book at the moment.
She usually stays at home in the morning.
They are not doing their homework tonight.
他们今晚没有在做作业。
It is a quarter past eight.
Do you want the large size or the small size?
Do you have any writing paper?
I don't have any small pads.
And I want a large box of chalk, too.
否定与一般疑问常用 any，肯定常用 some。envelopes 是可数复数；glue、writing paper 通常不可数。ones 代替复数物品，What else 表示还要什么。
I do not have any glue.
It is a quarter to nine.
Can you remember the doctor's telephone number?
你记得医生的电话号码吗？
What's the matter with him, doctor?
He has a bad cold, Mr. Williams, so he must stay in bed for a week.
威廉斯先生，他得了重感冒，因此他必须卧床一周。
这对吉米来说是个好消息。
What’s the matter with ...? 问怎么了。he has / he feels 描述状态；must 后用动词原形。身体不舒服时，可以用这些表达告诉大人。
What is the matter with him?
Can I see him please, Mrs. Williams?
威廉斯太太，我可以看看他吗？
You are better now, but you mustn't get up yet.
你现在好些了，但还不能起床。
You must stay in bed for another two days.
The boy mustn't go to school yet, Mrs. Williams.
